purpose: One bounded numerical-method diagnostic after both fixed h=0.1 author arms first rejected a lane at substep 190; a smaller ODE step may tighten Picard validation, but is not expected to settle the safety property on its own.

fixed_mathematical_contract.ledger: same 4 x 3 full-cover initial partition (12 boxes)
fixed_mathematical_contract.controller: same official 2026 ONNX, raw f(x) injected into u1; minus 10 in dx4 exactly once
fixed_mathematical_contract.property: all four physical states in [-2,2] for every time in [0,20]

fixed_other_method_settings.crown: box, same-slope, native input layout, rpc-float32

stop_rule: At first substep with any rejected initial box, write its observation, status codes and interval record, then stop the driver immediately; outer timeout 120 s.
classification: isolated numerical profile; not fixed h=0.1 main table and not a speed-ranking sample
